name: aegis
description: Air-gapped local LLM deployment CLI with Ink, FastAPI, ChromaDB, and Ollama.

scripts.install:cli: npm unlink -g aegis --silent || true && npm unlink -g @aegis/cli --silent || true && npm run build --workspace @aegis-ai/cli && npm link --workspace @aegis-ai/cli
scripts.uninstall:cli: npm unlink -g @aegis-ai/cli && npm unlink -g aegis --silent || true && npm unlink -g @aegis/cli --silent || true
